entries.title: Diplomat Sanctions are a family; Financier sanctions remain a future question
entries.summary: Blockade and related Diplomat cards may form a Sanctions family tied to refused or accepted Terms. Whether Financiers gain economically distinct Sanctions remains deferred.

entries.title: Assassins belongs to Intelligence and should remain harsh
entries.summary: Assassins is an expensive Intelligence card whose severity is intentional; it later received a Mission/faction context rather than being softened into generic Neutral interaction.

entries.title: Armistice remains Neutral rather than becoming a Diplomat card
entries.summary: Armistice was kept as high-complexity Neutral interaction; a Proposal may create temporary ceasefire effects without faction-locking the existing card.

entries.title: Arcane Knowledge classification discussion is superseded by the current Neutral card
entries.summary: Early discussion moved Arcane Knowledge toward the Arcane/Mystics faction, but the released current card is Neutral with the Arcane trait. Its incomplete digital Battle replay is separately quarantined.

entries.title: Attrition remains shared Neutral pressure
entries.summary: Attrition was debated between Military, Inquisition, and Advanced Neutral. The released resolution keeps it Neutral rather than treating general anti-stalemate attrition as faction-exclusive.

entries.title: Blockade is a Diplomat Sanction
entries.summary: Blockade moved from generic/Financier/Inquisition consideration into the Diplomat package as coercive sanctions connected to Terms.

entries.title: Reserve Embargo for Diplomats and rename the Neutral card Disruption
entries.summary: The old Neutral Embargo identity was renamed Disruption so Embargo could be used for a Diplomat Sanction.

entries.title: Capital Gains is a cost-three Financier card
entries.summary: Capital Gains remained in Financiers and was adjusted to cost 3 during the v0.6 package review.

entries.title: Capital Punishment remains expensive shared hard cancellation
entries.summary: Capital Punishment remains Advanced Neutral/shared access rather than becoming faction-exclusive.

entries.title: Conscription, Contraband, Counterintelligence, Court Martial, Decoys, Entrenchment, Fealty, Fortifications, and Illegal Occupation remain shared Neutral tools
entries.summary: The card migration pass kept these broadly useful functions in Neutral rather than overlocking basic draw, replay, protection, retreat, defense, and occupation tools.

entries.title: Fog of War is an Intelligence Overlay
entries.summary: Fog of War moved into Intelligence and is explicitly an Overlay; Engineers do not monopolize the Overlay card type.

entries.title: Fortifications extra withdrawal is voluntary
entries.summary: The additional withdrawal enabled by Fortifications is optional, not forced.

entries.title: Bombardment supersedes Neutral Siege Weaponry
entries.summary: The current Neutral Overlay card is Bombardment; Siege Weaponry is retired for this identity and reserved as a possible future Engineer concept.

entries.title: Current v0.6 exact card text supersedes the v0.5 conversation drafts
entries.summary: All v0.5-era exact card wordings and temporary classifications remain historical evidence only where they differ from the v0.6.0 canonical card pool and faction guides.
